title: Chapter 693 - 693 Benefits; Greatest Benefactor!
content:
Chapter 693 - 693 Benefits; Greatest Benefactor!

Chapter 693 - 693 Benefits; Greatest Benefactor!

693 Benefits; Greatest Benefactor!

The sudden change was completely unexpected for the Five Masters of the Gray Planet.

“Li Kai!” they cried out in shock.

However, Li Kai, who had been cut in half, was clearly unable to respond.

Lin Fan’s movements did not stop at all.

He swung his sword again.

Another sword light shot out, instantly cutting the man on the left into two.

“Lin En!”

The remaining three were all terrified and furious.

“Brat, how dare you?!”

“Bastard!”

“Let’s join forces to kill him!”

“I must kill him!”

The three of them took out their weapons and gathered their energy before flying toward Lin Fan.

It was as though he wanted to turn Lin Fan into ashes on the spot.

However, sometimes, even if one was prepared, even if one was angry, even if one used all their strength… It was completely useless.

Lin Fan waved the True Dragon Sword twice in a row. Two dazzling sword lights were like heavenly punishment as they swallowed the two men completely.

When the last man saw this, he was scared out of his wits and no longer had any thoughts of revenge or resistance.

When he looked at Lin Fan, it was like he was looking at the most terrifying demon in the world. He was terrified.

He hurriedly turned around and transformed into a stream of light as he fled into the unknown forest.

However, in front of absolute strength, escaping was just an extravagant hope.

Lin Fan slashed out once more.

A huge head rolled to the ground like a football.

Blood splattered!

Silence!

The entire scene was silent!

Even though they had said so much, it had only been a few seconds since Lin Fan pulled out his sword.

In a few seconds, five Star Traveller fighters were dead!

The famous Five Masters of the Gray Planet lost their lives just like that!

Ma Zheng could not help but swallow his saliva. His entire heart was shocked to the extreme.

When Lin Fan faced Star Traveller beasts, he killed them all easily.

Against Star Travellers, it was the same!

Earlier, Ma Zheng had already guessed that Lin Fan’s cultivation state had reached the Planet level.

Now, this conjecture was confirmed.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s heart was not calm either.

A series of notifications had sounded in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-six Planet cultivator. You’ve obtained 60,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-four Planet cultivator. You’ve obtained 40,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Planet cultivator. You’ve obtained 50,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Planet cultivator. You’ve obtained 50,000 experience points.]

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-five Planet cultivator. You’ve obtained 50,000 experience points.]

Killing cultivators was the same as killing beasts, and he could also gain experience points!

Energy surged into his heart.

However, Lin Fan’s emotions were getting a little complicated.

After all, cultivators were humans.

However, killing humans could increase one’s cultivation. This could easily lead one to become bewitched and go astray.

However, Lin Fan’s gaze turned resolute once more.

If people did not provoke him, he would not provoke them.

If someone tried to threaten him, he would just kill them?

Killing enemies and increasing cultivation, why not?

Then, Lin Fan waved his hand, and a bronze ring flew out from the finger of the first dead man.

[Spatial Ring: Do you want to spend 100 high-grade spirit stones to open it?]

In fact…

This was also the reason why Lin Fan had killed this man first.

Lin Fan did not know if there were any terrifying things within the Space Ring.

“Activate!”

The 100 spirit stones that were stored in Lin Fan’s internal space shattered instantly, turning into a stream of light and disappearing.

The interspatial ring in front of him let out a soft sound.

With a thought, Lin Fan took out all the items he had stored in his storage ring.

Swords, spears, spears, shields, and other weapons, as well as mountains of top-grade spirit stones and spirit crystals, various pills, and 11 Spiritual Pearls, all appeared on the ground.

These things all contained extraordinary auras and could be called treasures.

However, Lin Fan only glanced at them casually and did not take them to heart.

That was because Lin Fan had already obtained even more precious treasures from the system. Looking at these things, they naturally seemed very ordinary.

He raised his hand, and the golden spear flew into his hand.

“This is for you.”

Then, the spear flew in front of Ma Zheng.

Ma Zheng was slightly stunned. Then, he said excitedly, “Thank you, Senior Lin.”

When he touched the spear and felt the powerful aura emitted from it, he became even more excited.

“This… This is too valuable!”

Ma Zheng was an expert in using spears. He knew very well how precious this spear was.

Lin Fan said, “It’s just a small item. Take it.”

Lin Fan was definitely not spouting nonsense.

That was because this spear was indeed a small toy compared to the True Dragon Sword and other emperor-level weapons.

Ma Zheng did not dare to reject Lin Fan anymore.

Then, the two of them set foot on the road again.

…

Two days passed in the blink of an eye.

When Lin Fan and Ma Zheng arrived at a green forest, a strong fragrance filled the air.

“It smells so good,” Ma Zheng could not help but say.

After a while, his gaze fell on a golden tree not far away.

The tree was covered with fruits that looked like dragons.

“Dragon Development Fruit!”

A large lion with a pair of vertical pupils and a height of more than ten meters walked out with its teeth bared.

It took a step forward with its thick claws, and the entire space seemed to collapse.

A terrifying aura pressed down like a huge mountain.

Ma Zheng was so scared that his face turned pale. He could not help but take two steps back. His body trembled as he stuttered, “This… This aura… It’s a high-level Planet beast…”

As the sound of his voice faded, Lin Fan slashed out with his sword.

A hideous wound immediately appeared on the neck of the huge lion. Hot blood surged out like spring water.

The giant lion had no strength to resist at all. Its body fell to the ground like a mountain, losing all signs of life.

‘As expected of Senior Lin.’ Ma Zheng praised in his heart.

[Ding! You’ve killed a level-nine Planet exotic beast. You’ve obtained 90,000 experience points.]

In the next moment, the Dragon Development Fruit hanging on the tree and the Spiritual Pearl within the lion’s body all flew up in front of Lin Fan.

Lin Fan passed one of the Dragon Development Fruits over to Ma Zheng. As for the rest, he placed them into his internal space.

“Senior Lin, thank you!” Ma Zheng said excitedly.

After entering the Heavenly Wind World, not only did he obtain ten Spiritual Pearls and the opportunity to enter the core region, but he also obtained a high-grade spear and a Dragon Development Fruit.

It was definitely a great harvest!

Ma Zheng understood that all of this was because of Lin Fan.

In his heart, he had already treated Lin Fan as his benefactor—the greatest benefactor in his life!
